This documentation provides a comprehensive breakdown of the design system extracted from the **MyCryptoPilot** landing page.

# Design System Documentation: MyCryptoPilot

## 1. Core Principles
The design system follows a **"Cyber-Fintech Minimalist"** aesthetic. It combines the high-contrast, dark-mode look of modern trading platforms with sophisticated "Glassmorphism" and tactile textures.

*   **Risk-First Intelligence**: The UI uses high-contrast accents (Emerald vs. Crimson) to immediately communicate market sentiment and risk.
*   **Depth & Texture**: Uses layered backgrounds (Mesh gradients + SVG Grain) to create a premium, "physical" digital space.
*   **Precision & Clarity**: High-end typography (Sora) and generous whitespace emphasize data accuracy and professional-grade tools.

---

## 2. Color Palette

### Base Colors
| Name | Hex Code | Tailwind Class (Approx) | Usage |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Obsidian** | `#05070a` | `bg-[#05070a]` | Primary background color. |
| **Pure White** | `#ffffff` | `text-white` | Primary headings and body text. |

### Accent Colors
| Name | Hex Code | Tailwind Class | Usage |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Emerald** | `#00ffaa` | `text-[#00ffaa]` | Success states, "Growth", primary CTAs, and positive indicators. |
| **Crimson** | `#ff3366` | `text-[#ff3366]` | Risk indicators, "Danger", and negative market movements. |

### UI Accents
| Name | Value | Usage |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Glass Border** | `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1)` | Subtle borders for cards and navigation elements. |
| **Mesh Gradient** | Mixed Opacities | Background depth using Emerald (10%) and Crimson (8%). |

---

## 3. Typography
The system uses **Sora**, a geometric sans-serif designed for clarity in digital interfaces.

*   **Primary Font**: `Sora, sans-serif`
*   **Weights**: 
    *   `300` (Light): Secondary descriptions.
    *   `400` (Regular): Body text.
    *   `600` (Semi-bold): Sub-headings and buttons.
    *   `800` (Extra-bold): Hero titles and branding.
*   **Scale**:
    *   **Hero Title**: Likely `text-5xl` to `text-7xl` with `font-extrabold`.
    *   **Body**: `text-base` (16px) with `leading-relaxed`.

---

## 4. Spacing & Layout
*   **Container**: Standardized centered layouts with `max-width` (likely `max-w-7xl`).
*   **Layout Engine**: Flexbox and CSS Grid are used for structural alignment.
*   **Layering Strategy (Z-Index)**:
    *   `z-[-1]`: Mesh Gradients (Background depth).
    *   `z-[0]`: Main Content.
    *   `z-[50]`: Grain Texture (Overlay for tactile feel).
*   **Scrolling**: Smooth scrolling enabled via `scroll-smooth`.

---

## 5. Components

### 5.1 The "Hyper-Border" Container
A signature component used for cards and sections.
*   **Style**: Semi-transparent background with a `glass-border`.
*   **Effect**: Likely utilizes `backdrop-filter: blur()` to create a frosted glass effect over the mesh gradients.

### 5.2 Background System
The background is a composite of three layers:
1.  **Base Layer**: Solid `#05070a`.
2.  **Atmospheric Layer**: `.mesh-gradient` using radial gradients of Emerald and Crimson at low opacity.
3.  **Texture Layer**: `.grain` using a fractal noise SVG filter at `0.04` opacity to prevent "banding" in gradients and add a premium feel.

---

## 6. Iconography
*   **Style**: Thin-stroke, geometric icons.
*   **Implementation**: Likely Lucide or Phosphor Icons to match the `Sora` typeface's geometric nature.
*   **Coloring**: Icons should follow the accent palette (Emerald for features, Crimson for risk alerts).

---

## Reference HTML

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr" class="scroll-smooth">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>MyCryptoPilot | Risk-First Trading Intelligence</title>
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <script defer src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/alpinejs@3.x.x/dist/cdn.min.js"></script>
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Sora:wght@300;400;600;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    
    <style>
        :root {
            --bg-obsidian: #05070a;
            --accent-emerald: #00ffaa;
            --accent-crimson: #ff3366;
            --glass-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
        }

        body {
            font-family: 'Sora', sans-serif;
            background-color: var(--bg-obsidian);
            color: #ffffff;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            min-height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        .grain {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 50;
            opacity: 0.04;
            background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3Insight%3Cfilter id='noiseFilter'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.65' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noiseFilter)'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
        }

        .mesh-gradient {
            position: absolute;
            top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
            background: 
                radial-gradient(circle at 20% 30%, rgba(0, 255, 170, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%),
                radial-gradient(circle at 80% 70%, rgba(255, 51, 102, 0.08) 0%, transparent 50%);
            z-index: -1;
        }

        .hyper-border {
            position: relative;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
            border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
        }
    </style>
</head>
```

     2→import { getRequiredUser } from "@/lib/auth/auth-user";
     3→
     4→/**
     5→ * App Layout (User-Centric)
     6→ * Big Bang (Issue #77 Phase 11) - Multi-Sidebar Architecture Restored
     7→ *
     8→ * This layout only ensures user authentication.
     9→ * Each route group manages its own sidebar:
    10→ * - (trading)/* → TradingSidebar
    11→ * - (account)/* → AccountSidebar
    12→ * - (school)/* → SchoolSidebar
    13→ * - (tax)/* → TaxSidebar
    14→ *
    15→ * Routes are organized into 4 spaces:
    16→ * - Trading: /dashboard, /signals, /traders, /pricing, /checkout, /risk-console
    17→ * - Account: /account/*
    18→ * - School: /school/*
    19→ * - Tax: /tax/*
    20→ */
    21→export default async function AppLayout({ children }: PropsWithChildren) {
    22→  // Ensure user is authenticated
    23→  await getRequiredUser();
    24→
    25→  // Each route group handles its own layout with sidebar
    26→  return <>{children}</>;
    27→}

## RAPPORT D'EXPLORATION UI/UX - MYCRYPTOPILOT

Voici une vue d'ensemble structurée de l'architecture UI existante du projet MyCryptoPilot:

---

### 1. STRUCTURE DES PAGES (69 fichiers page.tsx)

#### Pages principales par zone:

**Trading Zone** (app/(app)/(trading)/):
- `/dashboard` - Tableau de bord utilisateur
- `/dashboard/trader` - Tableau de bord trader
- `/dashboard/trader/signals/new` - Créer un signal
- `/signals` - Flux des signaux
- `/traders` - Marketplace des traders
- `/traders/[traderId]` - Profil d'un trader
- `/following` - Traders suivis
- `/portfolio` - Suivi de portfolio
- `/analytics` - Analytics
- `/pricing` - Page pricing
- `/checkout/[plan]` - Paiement crypto
- `/risk-console` - Console de risque
- `/risk-console/history` - Historique risque
- `/trader-tools/referral` - Referral (traders)
- `/my-trades` - Mes trades

**Account Zone** (app/(app)/(account)/):
- `/account` - Profil principal
- `/account/settings` - Paramètres
- `/account/payments` - Historique paiements
- `/account/discord` - Intégration Discord
- `/account/exchanges` - Connexions exchanges (Binance, Bybit)
- `/account/following` - Traders suivis (duplicate?)
- `/account/become-trader` - Devenir trader
- `/account/change-email`, `/change-password`, `/danger` - Sécurité

**School Zone** (app/(app)/(school)/):
- `/school/courses` - Cours
- `/school/my-learning` - Mon apprentissage

**Tax Zone** (app/(app)/(tax)/):
- `/tax/import` - Import données
- `/tax/reports` - Rapports taxes

**Landing/Public** (app/(layout)/):
- `/` - Page d'accueil
- `/posts` - Blog
- `/posts/[slug]` - Article
- `/legal/privacy`, `/legal/terms` - Légal
- `/about`, `/contact` - Pages info

**Auth**:
- `/auth/signin`, `/auth/signup` - Authentification
- `/auth/verify`, `/auth/reset-password` - Vérification
- `/auth/new-user` - Onboarding

**Admin**:
- `/admin` - Dashboard admin
- `/admin/users`, `/admin/traders`, `/admin/signals` - Gestion
- `/admin/monitoring`, `/admin/payments`, `/admin/feedback` - Monitoring

---

### 2. STRUCTURE DES LAYOUTS

```
app/layout.tsx (Root)
├── app/(layout)/layout.tsx
│   └── BaseLayout (Header + Footer)
│       ├── Landing pages
│       └── Public pages
├── app/(app)/layout.tsx (Authentification requise)
│   ├── app/(app)/(trading)/layout.tsx
│   │   └── BaseSidebarLayout + TradingSidebar
│   │       └── Trading pages
│   ├── app/(app)/(account)/layout.tsx
│   │   └── BaseSidebarLayout + AccountSidebar
│   │       └── Account pages
│   ├── app/(app)/(school)/layout.tsx
│   │   └── BaseSidebarLayout + SchoolSidebar
│   │       └── School pages
│   └── app/(app)/(tax)/layout.tsx
│       └── BaseSidebarLayout + TaxSidebar
│           └── Tax pages
├── app/admin/layout.tsx
│   └── Admin layout + AdminSidebar
├── app/auth/layout.tsx
│   └── Auth layout
└── app/@modal/(.)auth/signin
    └── Interceptor modal
```

**Pattern clé**: Architecture **multi-sidebar** avec 4 espaces indépendants
- Chaque zone a sa propre sidebar
- BaseSidebarLayout partagé avec Layout wrapper et Breadcrumb automatique
- Max-width: 7xl appliqué globalement

---

### 3. SYSTÈME DE DESIGN TAILWIND & COULEURS

**CSS global** (`app/globals.css`):
- Tailwind v4 avec `@plugin "tailwindcss-animate"`
- **OKLch color system** (moderne) en mode light + dark
- Radius par défaut: 0.625rem

**Schéma couleurs**:

**Light Mode**:
```css
--background: oklch(1 0 0)          /* Blanc pur */
--foreground: oklch(0.145 0 0)      /* Noir quasi-pur */
--primary: oklch(0.205 0 0)         /* Noir */
--primary-foreground: oklch(0.985 0 0) /* Blanc */
--accent: oklch(0.97 0 0)           /* Gris très clair */
--border: oklch(0.922 0 0)          /* Gris très léger */
--input: oklch(0.922 0 0)           /* Gris léger */
--muted: oklch(0.97 0 0)            /* Gris clair */
```

**Dark Mode**:
```css
--background: oklch(0.145 0 0)      /* Noir quasi-pur */
--foreground: oklch(0.985 0 0)      /* Blanc pur */
--primary: oklch(0.6801 0.1583 276.9349) /* Purple/Bleu */
--primary-foreground: oklch(0.2077 0.0398 265.7549)
--card: oklch(0.2 0 0)              /* Gris très foncé */
```

**Couleurs auxiliaires**:
- Success: `hsl(151, 55%, 41%)`
- Warning: `hsl(24deg 94% 50%)` (Orange)
- Info: `hsl(221.2 83.2% 53.3%)` (Bleu)
- Destructive: OKLch rougeâtre

**Chart colors** (5 variables pour charts):
- chart-1 à chart-5 (OKLch différents hues)

---

### 4. TYPOGRAPHIES & FONTS

**Fonts Google intégrées**:
```typescript
// Dans app/layout.tsx
const CaptionFont = Space_Grotesk({
  variable: "--font-caption", // Headings
});
const GeistSans = Inter({
  variable: "--font-geist-sans", // Body text (par défaut)
});
const GeistMono = Geist_Mono({
  variable: "--font-geist-mono", // Code
});
```

**Typography Component** (`src/components/nowts/typography.tsx`):
Variants disponibles via CVA:
- `h1`: "font-caption text-4xl font-extrabold lg:text-5xl"
- `h2`: "font-caption text-3xl font-semibold"
- `h3`: "font-caption text-xl font-semibold"
- `p`: "leading-7"
- `large`: "text-lg font-semibold"
- `small`: "text-sm font-medium"
- `muted`: "text-sm text-muted-foreground"
- `lead`, `quote`, `code`, `link`

**CSS classes pour typography globales**:
```css
.typography h1 { font-size: var(--text-4xl); font-weight: 800; }
.typography h2 { font-size: var(--text-3xl); font-weight: 600; }
/* Spacing automatique entre éléments */
```

---

### 5. COMPOSANTS UI SHADCN (37 fichiers)

**Formulaires & Input**:
- `input.tsx` - Text input
- `form.tsx` - React Hook Form wrapper
- `select.tsx` - Select dropdown
- `checkbox.tsx` - Checkbox
- `radio-group.tsx` - Radio buttons
- `switch.tsx` - Toggle switch
- `textarea.tsx` - Text area
- `input-otp.tsx` - OTP input

**Navigation & Structure**:
- `sidebar.tsx` - Sidebar collapsible (Radix)
- `sidebar-utils.tsx` - Menu navigation
- `breadcrumb.tsx` - Breadcrumb navigation
- `pagination.tsx` - Pagination

**Disclosure**:
- `accordion.tsx` - Accordion (Radix)
- `collapsible.tsx` - Collapsible (Radix)
- `tabs.tsx` - Tabs (Radix)

**Overlay & Modal**:
- `dialog.tsx` - Modal dialog (Radix)
- `alert-dialog.tsx` - Confirmation dialog
- `popover.tsx` - Popover (Radix)
- `dropdown-menu.tsx` - Dropdown menu
- `sheet.tsx` - Side sheet

**Feedback & Data**:
- `badge.tsx` - Badge/tag
- `alert.tsx` - Alert banner
- `table.tsx` - Data table
- `chart.tsx` - Recharts wrapper
- `progress.tsx` - Progress bar
- `skeleton.tsx` - Loading skeleton
- `avatar.tsx` - Avatar image

**Utilities**:
- `button.tsx` - Button avec 6 variants (default, destructive, outline, secondary, ghost, link, invert, success, warning)
- `card.tsx` - Card container (voir détail ci-après)
- `label.tsx` - Form label
- `tooltip.tsx` - Tooltip (Radix)
- `toggle.tsx` - Toggle button
- `command.tsx` - Command palette
- `aspect-ratio.tsx` - Aspect ratio wrapper
- `sonner.tsx` - Toast notifications

---

### 6. COMPOSANTS CUSTOM (src/components/nowts/)

**Trading spécifiques**:
- `trading-card.tsx` (170 lignes) - Carte signal (LONG/SHORT, prix, TP/SL, graphique)
- `copy-trade-button.tsx` - Bouton copy trading
- `copy-trade-dialog.tsx` - Modal copy trading
- `follow-button.tsx` - Bouton follow/unfollow
- `risk-console-calculator.tsx` - Calculatrice position sizing

**Subscriptions & Paiements**:
- `subscription-card.tsx` (200+ lignes) - Affiche plan actif + expiration + upgrade
- `subscription-cta.tsx` (180+ lignes) - CTA upgrade avec couleurs plan
- `crypto-payment-option.tsx` - Option paiement (Base/Tron)
- `checkout-page.tsx` - Page paiement complète

**Referral & Gamification**:
- `referral-link-card.tsx` - Affiche lien referral
- `referral-earnings-card.tsx` - Revenus referral
- `tier-badge.tsx` - Badge tier/niveau
- `tier-progress-card.tsx` - Progression tier
- `top-invitees-card.tsx` - Top invités
- `credits-balance-card.tsx` - Solde crédits
- `credits-history-modal.tsx` - Historique crédits
- `rewards-catalog-modal.tsx` - Catalogue récompenses

**Data & Analytics**:
- `conversion-stats-card.tsx` - Stats conversion
- `detailed-funnel-card.tsx` - Entonnoir détaillé
- `period-selector.tsx` - Sélecteur période

**Invitations & Management**:
- `invitations-table.tsx` - Table invitations
- `enhanced-invitations-table.tsx` - Table améliorée
- `invitation-actions.tsx` - Actions invitation
- `invite-follower-dialog.tsx` - Modal inviter follower

**UI Générales**:
- `typography.tsx` - Typography component (flexible)
- `logo.tsx` - SVG logos (GitHub, Google, Discord)
- `page-breadcrumb.tsx` - Breadcrumb automatique
- `divider.tsx` - Diviseur visuel
- `grid-background.tsx` - Fond avec grille
- `bentoo.tsx` - Bento grid layout
- `keyboard-shortcut.tsx` - Affiche raccourci clavier
- `loader.tsx` - Spinner loading
- `chart-image-viewer.tsx` - Viewer image graphique
- `automatic-pagination.tsx` - Pagination auto

---

### 7. CARD COMPONENT (Architecture centrale)

```tsx
<Card>
  <CardHeader>
    <CardTitle>Titre</CardTitle>
    <CardDescription>Sous-titre</CardDescription>
    <CardAction>Action bouton</CardAction>
  </CardHeader>
  <CardContent>
    Contenu principal
  </CardContent>
  <CardFooter>
    Footer</CardFooter>
</Card>
```

**Styles**:
- Padding: 6 (24px) horizontalement, variable verticalement
- Border radius: `rounded-xl`
- Shadow: `shadow-sm`
- Border: `1px border`
- Flex container: `flex flex-col gap-6`

---

### 8. CONFIGURATION SITE (`src/site-config.ts`)

```typescript
{
  title: "MyCryptoPilot",
  description: "Signaux de trading crypto risk-first...",
  appUrl: "https://mycryptopilot.app",
  brand: {
    primary: "#F59E0B", // Amber (crypto theme)
  },
  crypto: {
    networks: {
      base: { currency: "USDC", confirmations: 1 },
      tron: { currency: "USDT", confirmations: 2 },
    },
    testnet: {
      base: "Base Sepolia",
      tron: "Tron Shasta",
    },
  },
  features: {
    enableImageUpload: true,
    enableLandingRedirection: false,
  },
}
```

---

### 9. BUTTON VARIANTS

```typescript
variant: {
  default: "bg-primary text-primary-foreground"
  destructive: "bg-destructive text-white"
  outline: "border hover:bg-accent"
  secondary: "bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground"
  ghost: "hover:bg-accent"
  link: "text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline"
  invert: "bg-foreground text-background"
  success: "bg-success text-success-foreground"
  warning: "bg-warning text-warning-foreground"
}

size: {
  default: "h-9 px-4"
  sm: "h-8 px-3"
  lg: "h-10 px-6"
  icon: "size-9"
}
```

---

### 10. SIDEBAR ARCHITECTURE

**Basés sur Radix UI Sidebar**:

**Navigation Links Pattern**:
```typescript
interface NavigationGroup {
  title: string;
  items: Array<{
    href: string;
    label: string;
    icon: LucideIcon;
    badge?: number;
    notification?: boolean;
  }>;
}
```

**Trading Sidebar** - Sections:
1. **MY FEED** - Dashboard, Signals
2. **DISCOVER** - Traders, Following
3. **MY TRADING** - Portfolio, My Trades, Risk Console
4. **PUBLISH** (si trader) - Create Signal, Signals Management
5. **INSIGHTS & GROWTH** - Analytics, Referral
6. **ACCOUNT** - Settings

**Account Sidebar** - Sections:
1. **PROFILE** - Account, Settings
2. **SECURITY** - Change Email, Password, Danger Zone
3. **INTEGRATIONS** - Discord, Exchanges
4. **TRADER** (si trader) - Become Trader, Signals
5. **SUBSCRIPTIONS** - Following, Payments

---

### 11. COMPOSANTS LANDING (Features principales)

Dans `/src/features/landing/`:
- `hero.tsx` - Section hero
- `bento-section.tsx` - Grille bento
- `comparison-table.tsx` - Tableau comparaison plans
- `cta-section.tsx` - Call-to-action
- `ecosystem-cycle-section.tsx` - Cycle écosystème
- `faq-section.tsx` - FAQ
- `feature-section.tsx` - Features showcase
- `risk-console-demo.tsx` - Demo console risque
- `review-grid.tsx`, `review-single.tsx`, `review-triple.tsx` - Testimonials
- `stats-section.tsx` - Statistiques
- `landing-header.tsx` - Header landing

---

### 12. RESPONSIVE & MOBILE

**Mobile-first approach**:
- Tailwind breakpoints: `sm`, `md`, `lg`, `xl`, `2xl`
- Sidebar: collapsible sur mobile (SidebarTrigger)
- Grid layouts utilisent `@container` pour adaptation
- Card header: `@container/card-header`

---

### 13. DARK MODE

- Activé via classe `.dark` sur `<html>`
- CSS variables dual-mode (light + dark)
- Theme automatique avec prefers-color-scheme
- Transition smooth entre modes

---

### 14. PATTERNS & CONVENTIONS

**Button Usage**:
```tsx
<Button variant="default" size="lg">
  Action
</Button>
<Button variant="outline" size="sm">
  Secondary
</Button>
```

**Card Usage**:
```tsx
<Card>
  <CardHeader>
    <CardTitle>Title</CardTitle>
  </CardHeader>
  <CardContent>Content</CardContent>
</Card>
```

**Forms**:
- React Hook Form + Zod validation
- Typography variant + input composés
- Form wrapper avec contexte

**Spacing**:
- Gap utilities: `gap-2`, `gap-4`, `gap-6` (8px, 16px, 24px)
- Padding via CardContent: `px-6`
- Vertical: `py-6`, `pt-6`, `pb-8`

---

## RÉSUMÉ ARCHITECTURE UI

**Stack**:
- Next.js 15 + App Router
- TypeScript strict
- TailwindCSS v4 (OKLch) + Tailwind Animate
- Shadcn/UI (37 components)
- Radix UI (primitives)
- Class Variance Authority (CVA)

**Système**:
- **Color System**: OKLch + CSS variables dynamiques
- **Typography**: Space Grotesk (headings), Inter (body), Geist Mono (code)
- **Components**: Composable, slot-based architecture
- **Layout**: Multi-sidebar pattern + BaseSidebarLayout
- **Responsive**: Mobile-first, container queries

**Couches**:
1. Global layout (Root → Layout groups → BaseSidebarLayout)
2. Page-specific components
3. Custom components (nowts) + Shadcn UI
4. Primitive utilities

Cette architecture est **prête pour une refonte UI complète** - tous les composants sont modulaires et les patterns établis facilitent la migration vers un nouveau design.

│       ├── Landing pages
│       └── Public pages
├── app/(app)/layout.tsx (Authentification requise)
│   ├── app/(app)/(trading)/layout.tsx
│   │   └── BaseSidebarLayout + TradingSidebar
│   │       └── Trading pages
│   ├── app/(app)/(account)/layout.tsx
│   │   └── BaseSidebarLayout + AccountSidebar
│   │       └── Account pages
│   ├── app/(app)/(school)/layout.tsx
│   │   └── BaseSidebarLayout + SchoolSidebar
│   │       └── School pages
│   └── app/(app)/(tax)/layout.tsx
│       └── BaseSidebarLayout + TaxSidebar
│           └── Tax pages
├── app/admin/layout.tsx
│   └── Admin layout + AdminSidebar
├── app/auth/layout.tsx
│   └── Auth layout
└── app/@modal/(.)auth/signin
    └── Interceptor modal
```

**Pattern clé**: Architecture **multi-sidebar** avec 4 espaces indépendants
- Chaque zone a sa propre sidebar
- BaseSidebarLayout partagé avec Layout wrapper et Breadcrumb automatique
- Max-width: 7xl appliqué globalement

**CSS global** (`app/globals.css`):

- Radius par défaut: 0.625rem

**Light Mode**:
```css
--background: oklch(1 0 0)          /* Blanc pur */
--foreground: oklch(0.145 0 0)      /* Noir quasi-pur */
--primary: oklch(0.205 0 0)         /* Noir */
--primary-foreground: oklch(0.985 0 0) /* Blanc */
--accent: oklch(0.97 0 0)           /* Gris très clair */
--border: oklch(0.922 0 0)          /* Gris très léger */
--input: oklch(0.922 0 0)           /* Gris léger */
--muted: oklch(0.97 0 0)            /* Gris clair */
```

**Dark Mode**:
```css
--background: oklch(0.145 0 0)      /* Noir quasi-pur */
--foreground: oklch(0.985 0 0)      /* Blanc pur */
--primary: oklch(0.6801 0.1583 276.9349) /* Purple/Bleu */
--primary-foreground: oklch(0.2077 0.0398 265.7549)
--card: oklch(0.2 0 0)              /* Gris très foncé */
```

**Couleurs auxiliaires**:
- Success: `hsl(151, 55%, 41%)`
- Warning: `hsl(24deg 94% 50%)` (Orange)
- Info: `hsl(221.2 83.2% 53.3%)` (Bleu)
- Destructive: OKLch rougeâtre

**Chart colors** (5 variables pour charts):
- chart-1 à chart-5 (OKLch différents hues)

## RÉSUMÉ ARCHITECTURE UI

**Stack**:
- Next.js 15 + App Router
- TypeScript strict
- TailwindCSS v4 (OKLch) + Tailwind Animate
- Shadcn/UI (37 components)
- Radix UI (primitives)
- Class Variance Authority (CVA)

**Système**:
- **Color System**: OKLch + CSS variables dynamiques
- **Typography**: Space Grotesk (headings), Inter (body), Geist Mono (code)
- **Components**: Composable, slot-based architecture
- **Layout**: Multi-sidebar pattern + BaseSidebarLayout
- **Responsive**: Mobile-first, container queries

**Couches**:
1. Global layout (Root → Layout groups → BaseSidebarLayout)
2. Page-specific components
3. Custom components (nowts) + Shadcn UI
4. Primitive utilities

Cette architecture est **prête pour une refonte UI complète** - tous les composants sont modulaires et les patterns établis facilitent la migration vers un nouveau design.

# Plan de Refonte UI/UX - MyCryptoPilot

## Résumé

Refonte complète de l'interface utilisateur vers un design system **"Cyber-Fintech Minimalist"** dark-only avec glassmorphism, grain texture, et accents emerald/crimson.

---

## Phase 1: Foundation - Design Tokens (Priorité Critique)

### 1.1 Variables CSS et Couleurs
**Fichier:** `app/globals.css`

Remplacer le système de couleurs OKLch par:
```css
:root {
  /* Backgrounds */
  --bg-obsidian: #05070a;
  --bg-onyx: #0a0d12;
  --bg-graphite: #12161d;
  --bg-slate: #1a1f28;

  /* Accents */
  --accent-emerald: #00ffaa;
  --accent-crimson: #ff3366;

  /* Text */
  --text-primary: #ffffff;
  --text-secondary: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
  --text-muted: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);

  /* Glass */
  --glass-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  --glass-border-hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  --glass-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}
```

Ajouter classes utilitaires glassmorphism dans `@layer utils`:
```css
.glass {
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  background: var(--glass-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
}

.hyper-border {
  background: var(--glass-bg);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  border-radius: 16px;
}

.grain-overlay {
  background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,..."); /* SVG noise */
  opacity: 0.04;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.mesh-gradient {
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 10% 10%, rgba(0, 255, 170, 0.05) 0%, transparent 40%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 90% 90%, rgba(255, 51, 102, 0.04) 0%, transparent 40%);
}
```

### 1.2 Police Sora
**Fichier:** `app/layout.tsx`

Remplacer Inter par Sora:
```tsx
import { Sora, Geist_Mono } from "next/font/google";

const SoraFont = Sora({
  subsets: ["latin"],
  weight: ["300", "400", "600", "800"],
  variable: "--font-sora",
});
```

### 1.3 Supprimer le Light Mode
- Supprimer le bloc `.dark {}` et fusionner dans `:root`
- Supprimer `@custom-variant dark`
- Ajouter `class="dark"` sur `<html>` par défaut

---

## Phase 2: Composants UI Core

### 2.1 Card avec hyper-border
**Fichier:** `src/components/ui/card.tsx`

Ajouter variante `hyper`:
```tsx
const cardVariants = cva("flex flex-col gap-6 rounded-xl", {
  variants: {
    variant: {
      default: "bg-card border shadow-sm",
      hyper: "bg-[var(--glass-bg)] backdrop-blur-xl border border-[var(--glass-border)] hover:border-[var(--glass-border-hover)] transition-colors",
    }
  },
  defaultVariants: { variant: "default" }
});
```

### 2.2 Button avec emerald/crimson
**Fichier:** `src/components/ui/button.tsx`

Nouvelles variantes à ajouter:
```tsx
emerald: "bg-[#00ffaa] text-[#05070a] hover:bg-[#00ffaa]/90 font-semibold",
crimson: "bg-[#ff3366] text-white hover:bg-[#ff3366]/90",
glass: "bg-transparent border border-[var(--glass-border)] backdrop-blur-sm hover:border-[var(--glass-border-hover)] hover:bg-white/5",
```

### 2.3 Input glass style
**Fichier:** `src/components/ui/input.tsx`

Modifier les classes de base:
```tsx
className="bg-[var(--bg-graphite)] border-[var(--glass-border)] focus:border-[#00ffaa]/50 focus:ring-[#00ffaa]/20 placeholder:text-[var(--text-muted)]"
```

### 2.4 Badge avec accents
**Fichier:** `src/components/ui/badge.tsx`

Nouvelles variantes:
```tsx
emerald: "bg-[#00ffaa]/10 text-[#00ffaa] border-[#00ffaa]/20",
crimson: "bg-[#ff3366]/10 text-[#ff3366] border-[#ff3366]/20",
glass: "bg-transparent border-[var(--glass-border)]",
```

### 2.5 Tabs glass style
**Fichier:** `src/components/ui/tabs.tsx`

- TabsList: `bg-[var(--bg-graphite)]`
- TabsTrigger actif: `data-[state=active]:text-[#00ffaa]`

### 2.6 Sidebar dark theme
**Fichier:** `src/components/ui/sidebar.tsx`

- Background: `bg-[var(--bg-onyx)]`
- Menu items hover: `hover:bg-white/5`
- Border: `border-[var(--glass-border)]`

---

## Phase 3: Composants Custom Trading

### 3.1 TradingCard refonte
**Fichier:** `src/components/nowts/trading-card.tsx`

- Style hyper-border avec glass effect
- LONG: accent `#00ffaa` (emerald)
- SHORT: accent `#ff3366` (crimson)
- Hover glow effect

### 3.2 Stats Cards (nouveau composant)
**Créer:** `src/components/nowts/stats-card.tsx`

Card métrique avec:
- Glass background
- Valeur principale en Sora 800
- Trend indicator (emerald = up, crimson = down)

### 3.3 Subscription Cards
**Fichier:** `src/components/nowts/subscription-card.tsx`

- Tier "popular" avec border emerald
- Glass style
- CTA button emerald

---

## Phase 4: Pages - Par Ordre de Priorité

### 4.1 Landing Page (Page critique)
**Fichier:** `app/page.tsx`
**Template:** `landing_page___value_prop.html`

Sections:
1. Hero avec mesh gradient + grain texture
2. Stats (3 metrics en glass cards)
3. Features grid
4. Testimonials
5. Pricing tiers
6. CTA final

### 4.2 Auth Pages
**Fichiers:** `app/auth/signin/page.tsx`, `app/auth/signup/page.tsx`
**Template:** `authentication_portal.html`

- Background obsidian avec mesh gradient
- OAuth buttons avec glass style

### 4.3 Dashboard Principal
**Fichier:** `app/(app)/(trading)/dashboard/page.tsx`
**Template:** `main_command_center.html`

- Grid stats cards

- Quick actions

### 4.4 Traders Marketplace
**Fichier:** `app/(app)/(trading)/traders/_components/traders-list-client.tsx`
**Template:** `trader_marketplace.html`

- Filtres glass
- Cards traders hyper-border
- Grid responsive

### 4.5 Signals Feed
**Fichier:** `app/(app)/(trading)/signals/page.tsx`
**Template:** `premium_signal_feed.html`

### 4.6 Checkout Crypto
**Fichier:** `src/components/checkout/checkout-form.tsx`
**Template:** `crypto_payment_terminal.html`

### 4.7 Risk Console
**Fichier:** `app/(app)/(trading)/risk-console/page.tsx`
**Template:** `professional_risk_console.html`

### 4.8 Trader Profile Public
**Fichier:** `app/(app)/(trading)/traders/[traderId]/page.tsx`
**Template:** `trader_public_profile.html`

### 4.9 Exchange Integration
**Fichier:** `app/(app)/(account)/account/exchanges/page.tsx`
**Template:** `api_exchange_integration.html`

### 4.10 Become Trader Form
**Fichier:** `app/(app)/(account)/account/become-trader/page.tsx`
**Template:** `trader_application_form.html`

### 4.11 Create Signal Form
**Fichier:** `app/(app)/(trading)/dashboard/trader/signals/new/page.tsx`
**Template:** `signal_publication_console.html`

### 4.12 Trader Dashboard
**Fichier:** `app/(app)/(trading)/dashboard/trader/page.tsx`
**Template:** `trader_management_dashboard.html`

### 4.13 Analytics
**Fichier:** `app/(app)/(trading)/analytics/page.tsx`
**Template:** `verified_performance_analytics.html`

### 4.14 Copy Trading Setup
**Template:** `manual_copy_setup.html`
- Créer ou modifier page existante

---

## Phase 5: Layouts et Navigation

### 5.1 Base Sidebar Layout
**Fichier:** `app/(app)/_navigation/base-sidebar-layout.tsx`

- Background: `bg-[var(--bg-onyx)]`
- Header: `border-b border-[var(--glass-border)]`
- Content: `bg-[var(--bg-obsidian)]`

### 5.2 Trading Sidebar
**Fichier:** `app/(app)/(trading)/_navigation/trading-sidebar.tsx`

- Menu items glass hover
- Icons nouvelle palette
- Active state emerald

### 5.3 Landing Header
**Fichier:** `src/features/landing/landing-header.tsx`

- Links hover emerald
- CTA button emerald

### 6.1 Animations
- Hover effects cohérents
- Page transitions

Refonte complète de l'interface utilisateur vers un design system **"Cyber-Fintech Minimalist"** dark-only avec glassmorphism, grain texture, et accents emerald/crimson.

---

## Phase 1: Foundation - Design Tokens (Priorité Critique)

### 1.1 Variables CSS et Couleurs
**Fichier:** `app/globals.css`

Remplacer le système de couleurs OKLch par:
```css
:root {
  /* Backgrounds */
  --bg-obsidian: #05070a;
  --bg-onyx: #0a0d12;
  --bg-graphite: #12161d;
  --bg-slate: #1a1f28;

  /* Accents */
  --accent-emerald: #00ffaa;
  --accent-crimson: #ff3366;

  /* Text */
  --text-primary: #ffffff;
  --text-secondary: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
  --text-muted: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4);

  /* Glass */
  --glass-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  --glass-border-hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  --glass-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.02);
}
```

Ajouter classes utilitaires glassmorphism dans `@layer utils`:
```css
.glass {
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  background: var(--glass-bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
}

.hyper-border {
  background: var(--glass-bg);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
  border-radius: 16px;
}

.grain-overlay {
  background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,..."); /* SVG noise */
  opacity: 0.04;
  pointer-events: none;
}

.mesh-gradient {
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 10% 10%, rgba(0, 255, 170, 0.05) 0%, transparent 40%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 90% 90%, rgba(255, 51, 102, 0.04) 0%, transparent 40%);
}
```

});
